issues_detected.title: Water Staining Around Toilet Base
issues_detected.description: There is visible water staining and discoloration around the base of the toilet, indicating a possible leak from the toilet seal.
issues_detected.recommendation: Inspect the toilet seal and wax ring for damage and replace if necessary. Ensure the toilet is properly secured to prevent future leaks.

analysis.overall_assessment: Moderate plumbing issue detected with potential for water damage if not addressed.
